A '''three-eared creature''' resembling a [[Rabbit/Legends|rabbit]] lived on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], and it attempted to eat a scroll containing a list of the Ewok [[Latara/Legends|Latara]]'s stolen items, as the list was so long that it stretched from the Ewoks' treetop home of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] down to the ground of Endor, where the creature resided.<ref name="2-06" />
